stem:
Divya spills a little water on a polished steel plate and the same amount on dry garden soil. After some time both wet patches look smaller.

What best explains the disappearing water?

options.text: On steel the water mainly evaporates; on soil it can both seep in and evaporate.
On steel the water seeped into the metal, just as it seeps into soil.
Neither case involves evaporation; no white mist was visible.
Water that seeps into soil turns into vapour as soon as it goes below the surface.

teacher.key_rationale: Steel blocks seepage, so drying there is evaporation; soil allows both seepage and evaporation.
